messages:
claire: starting micro-canary for v8-hybrid3 on 0.4% traffic. main signals: rerank_ndcg5, template_hallucination_rate, token_retention_rate, latency_p95. auto-fallback: rerank_ndcg5 drop >1.5% rel over 10m OR hallucination +0.7% abs over 5m -> immediate rollback. tagging as 'hybrid3-stability-cohort'.

ben: baseline for comparison? v8-fp16-prod?

claire: yes baseline = v8-fp16-prod. hybrid3 is a new 3-bit hybrid kernel with focused head-calib.

otto: add watch slice 'templated_responses' and bump its samples to 350. also pin high-touch client 'delta-partners' to fp16 for the run.

claire: done  added templated_responses (n=350) and pinned delta-partners. smoke config: default n=200, templated_responses=350, report_interval=120s.

claire: gate config:
```
gate_id: hybrid3-stability-4321
canary_fraction: 0.004
watch_slices: ["templated_responses","midtail_rerank","short_q"]
metrics:
  - rerank_ndcg5: {threshold_rel: -1.5%, window_s: 600, action: immediate_rollback}
  - template_hallucination_rate: {threshold_abs: +0.7%, window_s: 300, action: immediate_rollback_if_concordance<95%}
  - token_retention_rate: {threshold_abs: -1.0%, window_s: 300, action: alert}
  - latency_p95: {threshold_rel: +4%, window_s: 300, action: alert}
autofallback_cooldown_s: 3600
notify: ["#eng-ml","#eng-oncall"]
report_interval_s: 120
sample_diffs_on_trigger: true
```

gate-bot: run started t=0. cohorts: templated_responses(n=350), midtail_rerank(n=200), short_q(n=200). posting every 2m.

ben: please enable token-edit-distance logging for templated responses; helps detect subtle truncation.

claire: enabled token-edit logging for templated_responses.

gate-bot: t+2m report: rerank_ndcg5 delta = -0.6% (ok), template_hallucination_rate = +0.2% (ok), token_retention_rate = -0.2% (ok), latency_p95 = +1.1% (ok).

otto: good. keep an eye on midtail; hybrid kernels previously showed small nondet noise on tie-breaks.

gate-bot: t+8m report: templated_responses template_hallucination_rate delta = +0.75% -> exceeds +0.7% threshold. concordance = 93.7% (<95%). triggering immediate rollback for hybrid3 cohort and posting sample diffs.

claire: ack. reducing hybrid3 fraction to 0.0 and enabling circuit-breaker. pulling diffs now. please pause any dependent promos.

ben: can you paste 2 short diffs inline for quick triage?

claire: pasted 2 trimmed diffs: 
- id 2210: fp16: "Please confirm your booking reference: [REF-123]" -> hybrid3: "Please confirm your booking ref: [REF-1234]" (extra digit inserted)
- id 2245: fp16: "Invoice total: $1,200.00" -> hybrid3: "Invoice total: $1,200.00 (approx)" (spurious qualifier)

otto: those look like head-softmax calibration shifts and occasional sub-token rounding. file ML-5580 for quant-head recalibration and tokenizer alignment.

sara: add guard: if hallucination-triggered rollback occurs, block auto-promote for all hybrid-* variants for 48h unless manually approved. also notify product for potential customer impact.

claire: guard added. created ticket ML-5580 and scheduled 45m triage. assigning follow-ups: 1) revert recent head-calib in hybrid3 build 2) run offline sim on templated_responses n=10k with token-edit logging 3) re-run canary with templated_responses n=1k and require 2 consecutive clean reports.

gate-bot: diffs posted to secure blob (link). alerting #eng-oncall and paging SRE on repeat rollback within 30m.

ben: thanks. quick note: revert only the head-calib patch + keep kernel perf flags; we want to preserve latency gains if possible.

claire: noted. short triage meeting in 15. summary: hybrid3 micro-canary rolled back due to templated_responses hallucination spike (+0.75%); circuit-breaker applied, VIP pinned, diffs captured, follow-ups logged. thanks all :mask:
